findings.description: Hard house-rule breach. iso-24495-5/SKILL.md, rule 4, requires a named minimum presentation width for comparison tables and a read-back at that width. Without a named width, it requires repeated labelled records. The new Inventory and Exact identities tables at lines 19–24 and 28–31 have no named presentation width anywhere in the document.
findings.required_change: Replace both tables with repeated labelled records. Alternatively, obtain a minimum target width, name it, and record the required read-back. Preserve every boundary, wire identity, ownership statement, and support restriction.
